description:
At pkix-revocation/src/signer_discovery.rs:87 vs :139:

  pub fn discover_crl_signer<'a>(bundle: &'a [Certificate], crl: &CertificateList) -> Option<&'a Certificate>
  pub(crate) fn reaches_self_signed(bundle: &[Certificate], signer: &Certificate) -> bool

The crate exports discover_crl_signer (re-exported through lib.rs line ~738) but withholds reaches_self_signed.

What callers cannot do:

A caller wanting to perform RFC 5280 §6.3.3(f) gating themselves — perhaps because they want to use a CRL signer cert in a different context (an OCSP responder cert lookup, a downstream pkix-chain composition that needs the anchor proof for telemetry, a strict pre-flight check) — can:

1. Call discover_crl_signer to find the candidate.
2. Do something with the cert.

But they CANNOT:

3. Independently verify the candidate chains back to a self-signed cert in the bundle, because reaches_self_signed is pub(crate). They have to rebuild that walk themselves OR call new_with_signer_discovery (which performs the gate as a side effect of constructing a CrlChecker, an object they may not need).

This creates a 'half-public API' shape: the discovery half is callable; the anchor-reachability half is not. The contract is internally consistent inside CrlChecker::new_with_signer_discovery but inconsistent for an external caller.

Two coherent designs, pick one:

(A) HIGH-LEVEL ONLY: drop the pub from discover_crl_signer. Only expose new_with_signer_discovery (or a single facade function that returns Result<&Certificate, Error>). Callers cannot do step (1) above without going through the gate. This collapses two pub items into one and removes the half-public surface.

(B) FULL-LOW-LEVEL: also export reaches_self_signed (and probably find_parent's logic via some seam). Callers who want to compose the pieces can. This commits more surface but is internally coherent.

Current (mixed) state is the worst of both: exposes the discriminator step but withholds the gate step, forcing every external caller to either re-implement reaches_self_signed or use the high-level CrlChecker constructor.

Recommendation: (A). discover_crl_signer's only real consumer inside this workspace is new_with_signer_discovery. Pre-launch is the right moment to demote it to pub(crate). If a future external use case appears, promoting it back is non-breaking; demoting later is breaking.

If (B) is chosen, also need to think about cert_authority_key_id / cert_subject_key_id (currently private helpers). The pub split is not at a natural seam.

Acceptance: a decision recorded; if (A), demote discover_crl_signer to pub(crate) and remove its re-export from lib.rs.
title: discover_crl_signer is pub but reaches_self_signed is pub(crate); callers cannot reproduce §6.3.3(f) gate
